title: [GMCP 203.044.02] Production path: Inspector, debugger, record/replay, mocks, and test laboratory
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-044-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: An operator can inspect negotiated capabilities, schemas, calls, subscriptions, tasks and traces; validate a server; replay a redacted deterministic transcript; inject latency/faults; and generate configurable mock clients or servers from contracts. Sensitive fields are removed before persistence, replay cannot perform side effects by default, formats are versioned, and CLI/TUI plus official Inspector workflows agree. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
